description: Implementation of H264BitReader class for parsing H.264 bitstreams, including emulation prevention handling and bit reading functions.

classes.name: H264BitReader
classes.description: A class for reading bits from an H.264 encoded bitstream, handling emulation prevention bytes and providing bit-level access.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the bit reader with data buffer and size, setting up internal state.

methods.name: UpdateCurrByte
methods.description: Loads the next byte from the data stream, handling emulation prevention sequences.

methods.name: ReadBits
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bits (1-31) from the stream into an output variable.

methods.name: NumBitsLeft
methods.description: Returns the total number of bits remaining to be read.

methods.name: HasMoreRBSPData
methods.description: Checks if there is more RBSP data available in the stream.

methods.name: NumEmulationPreventionBytesRead
methods.description: Returns the count of emulation prevention bytes encountered during reading.
